title: Training Episode v1 and Koffer corpus instrumentation

claims: Training Episode capture is opt-in and disabled by default.
Normalized episodes are separate from Grapher and retain Order, testimony, independent evaluation, execution lineage, artifact fingerprints, and usage metadata.
Human feedback is append-only and joins episodes only at export time.
Reviewed exports can assign a reproducible train/eval split without mutating historical episodes.
Generated Dreadnought workspace instructions explicitly preserve the Grapher-versus-training-data boundary.
Koffer is documented as the first intended live development case study before any Granite weight update.
Pinned Grapher v0.7 validation debt discovered during verification was normalized through Grapher history and now validates cleanly.
Generated .dreadnought/training corpus rows are Git-ignored by default and require explicit operator publication.
